scope: AIRA only; per-source-frame semantic landmarks; no source image changes

semanticFrameLandmarksCandidate.measurementMethod: All 27 original AIRA frames inspected individually at 3x nearest-neighbor with 16px source grid; screenshot-assisted error review R016. Values are candidates and require runtime fit recheck. Root cross-check supplied attack04 neck/chest/hand/ankle/hammer points. R008 adds metadata-only detail size/angle candidates; not a fit approval. R009 individually re-read all 27 3x source grids for visible screen-right boot cuff (leg/boot junction); workingPalm is explicitly null/occluded because fingers are covered by armored gloves.

rows.measurementNotes: Read against individual 3x nearest-neighbor source image with 16px grid. Candidate point is visible physical contact/center, not proof of runtime fit; original pixels unchanged. R009: screen-right boot cuff/leg-to-boot seam measured on individual 3x source grid; visibleRightAnkle aliases this cuff landmark for the current FEET consumer. workingPalm is explicitly occluded because armored gloves cover fingers/palm; null prevents ring fallback to glove/wrist. Candidate only; source untouched.
